description: Control the Sonos speakers in your home by talking to ChatGPT. Play songs, artists, albums and playlists, set the volume, group rooms together, move the music to another room, switch to TV, and have a speaker read out a short announcement or a timed reminder. It works in English and Chinese and goes through the official Sonos cloud, so there is nothing to install on your network and it works when you are away from home. You need the free ZoneFoundry iOS app, signed in to your own Sonos account; when you connect, you approve access in the app with a 6-digit code, and you can disconnect ChatGPT from the app at any time.

defaultPrompt: Play some relaxing jazz in the living room

Announce "dinner is ready" in every room
